nom: Proactiv Post Acne Dark Mark Relief

concerns.spots: Reviewers describe the product primarily against post-acne dark marks and pigmentation; several report gradual fading over weeks to months (reviews 11, 12, 16, 17, 18, 24, 29, 30, 32, 37, 40), while a comparable number report no visible change even after months of consistent use (reviews 2, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10).
concerns.blemishes: A few reviewers mention using it after active acne or alongside acne concerns; one notes it did not help her son's ongoing acne (review 36), and another says a prior dark-spot corrector worked better for acne-related marks (review 2).

aspects.libelle: Reduces post-acne dark marks over time
No visible change despite months of use

extraits.texte: Not doing its job. The old dark spot corrector was great. This one is not working as it should.

This product is great in terms of not making my skin feel too dry nor too oily when used. After a couple weeks of using it, I do believe I've seen a little improvement in some of the areas I have been using it on acne scars. However, the main area of issue which inspired me to get this product in the first place has unfortunately not shown any improvement.
Not an overnight fix but I do see it slowly fading away dark marks. Doesn't seem to irritate the skin.
My daughter has brown skin so her scares appear darker. All scaring from acne has disappeared!
Great product. I can see the dark spots on my face fading. I like the product because it's not Greasy and makes my skin feel grat
Haven't seen any good results yet on my son's face he has pretty bad acne
It isn't working at all and my daughters pores are starting to get bigger since she's been using proactive.

reserve: Almost no reviewer states her own skin type (oily, dry, combination, mature, normal), so segmentation by skin type could not be produced from this batch.
